description: This file defines custom attributes for implicit stream subscriptions in Orleans, including classes for marking grains with stream subscription metadata and filtering predicates.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute
classes.description: Attribute used to mark grains for implicit stream subscriptions with various constructors for different predicate configurations.

classes.name: RegexImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute
classes.description: Sealed class inheriting from ImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute, used to filter stream subscriptions with a regex pattern.

methods.name: GetBindings
methods.description: Generates binding metadata for the grain class based on the predicate and grain type.

methods.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute()
methods.description: Default constructor that subscribes to all stream namespaces.

methods.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute(string streamNamespace, string streamIdMapper = null)
methods.description: Constructor to subscribe to a specific stream namespace with optional stream ID mapper.

methods.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute(Type predicateType, string streamIdMapper = null)
methods.description: Constructor to pass a predicate type for filtering stream namespaces.

methods.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute(IStreamNamespacePredicate predicate, string streamIdMapper = null)
methods.description: Constructor to pass an instance of a predicate directly.

methods.name: RegexImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute(string pattern)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a regex-based stream namespace predicate for filtering.
